senses.gloss: to drip, be wet. Y. B. Mets. VI, beg. 10ᵈ שדהו זָלְחָה his field was too wet (for work).

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13">Num. R. s. 13</cite>, beg. <he>מכבדות וזולחות וכ׳</he> (not <he>וזוחלות</he>) the winds sweep and sprinkle all the perfumes &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:37">Yalk. Cant. 988</cite> <he>זולחת ומכבדת</he>, read: <he>מכ׳ וזוֹחֶלֶת</he>; cmp. <cite ref="G00480"><he>זְלוֹחָאָה</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Shekalim 1:12">Tosef. Shek. I, 12</cite> <he>יִזְלַח לו זֶלַח וכ׳</he> (or <he>יְזַלֵּחַ</he>) one may use it for sprinkling before his bier (Y. ib. II, 47ᵃ top <he>יעשה לו זלוף</he>).

senses.gloss: to sprinkle the floor for cooling or perfuming the air.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:4">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:3">XVII</cite>), 3 <he>אין מְזַלְּחִין את הבית וכ׳</he> (not <he>החבית</he>) one must not (on the Sabbath) sprinkle the house with any kind of sprinkling fluids.
